_collection.text: Tencent is not a bad stock but unfortunately investors & funds have no confidence in Chinese stocks even though it is making money. Regulator can easily change the rule of the game and Tencent can be hit badly like Alibaba. Looking at recent technical, it may trend lower. It is still very volatile and trade short-term. Take profit whenever you see a 5-10% surge.

replies.text: u are talking about the whole Chinese market. foreign funds already reached peak fear now just waiting for another shoe to drop if Biden gonna impose more trade sanctions. it already got hit by regulation last year and the one responsible was promptly replaced. wechat ain't going anywhere. u know. in the past year,  if u wanna travel to China the gov ask to download mini app through tencent... just like banking last September. it was clear the ccp is going to hold it up.do what  u want it's your money. I am happy with my investments.
